from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,textdistance
import textdistance.algorithms.edit_based as module
p=Path(module.__file__).resolve();assert p==(Path.cwd()/'textdistance/algorithms/edit_based.py').resolve()
rows=[]
for name,truncate,left,right,expected in [('default',False,'abc','ax',2),('truncate',True,'abc','ax',1),('empty',True,'','',0),('same',True,'abc','abc',0)]:
 try:
  value=textdistance.Hamming(external=False,truncate=truncate)(left,right);rows.append({'case':name,'truncate':truncate,'left':left,'right':right,'value':value,'type':type(value).__name__,'expected':expected,'correct':type(value) is int and value==expected})
 except Exception as e:rows.append({'case':name,'truncate':truncate,'left':left,'right':right,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e),'expected':expected,'correct':False})
print(json.dumps({'source_path':str(p),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'observations':rows},sort_keys=True))
PYOBSERVE
